The three positive permutations are explicit and pairwise disjoint. Two independent exhaustive finite algorithms reconstruct all 33 matchings and the same full 96-edge flip relation. A complete 33-row certificate is regenerated and checked; all 30 negative matchings are connected with exact diameter four and the other three are isolated. The input graph and quantifiers are fixed, so this exhaustive finite proof has no extrapolated domain.

value.rationale: All abstract girth-six cycles form a natural local matching-move system on the standard cubic symmetric Möbius–Kantor graph. A complete classification of its reachability structure is independently motivated by the question whether local dimer flips can explore all states. The finding shows an exact parity/isolated-state obstruction with a 30-vertex connected class and sharp diameter four, and identifies the three frozen states as an edge-partitioning one-factorization. The exact transition structure is richer than a known matching count and is reproducible without external software.
